1 The above financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th Sep, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 04.11.2026 and a limited review of the same was carried out by the Statutory Auditor of the Company.

2 In accordance with the requirements under Indian Accounting Standard (Ind AS) 108 on Operating Segments ,the Company has identified sale of Steel, Power and Logistics as primary business segments. Accordingly segment information has been disclosed as follows:
(a) The steel segment includes production and marketing operations of Sponge iron, Billets & Rebars (TMT).
(b) The power segment includes generation and marketing operations of Thermal based power.
(c) The logistics segment includes handling of bulk cargo through Railway Rakes, Transportation etc.

3 During the quarter, the Company availed a Working Capital Term Loan of Rs.1,119.00 lakhs under the ECLGS framework from Kotak Mahindra Bank sanctioned on 20th July 2026. The loan carries an interest rate of 9% p.a. for a 5-year tenure, including a 1-year principal moratorium. The facility is secured by a second charge on all assets available for existing working capital limits.

4 The 3,828, 14.06 % Listed, rated, redeemable, secured, Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) of .10,00,000 each (issue price) held by Kotak Credit Opportunities Fund are stated at reduced face value of 3,87,345 each NCD as on 30.09.2026 after part payment of stipulated mandatory payments to the NCD holders during the quarter.

5 SEIL Infra Logistics Limited, was incorporated on June 29, 2025 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Steel Exchange India Limited. During the quarter, the Company made a further investment of Rs.5 lakhs in its wholly owned subsidiary. As at the reporting date, the subsidiary had not commenced commercial operations.

6 Provisions for taxes, provision for acturial valuation on employee benefits, bonus etc. shall be provided at the year end.

7 Other income includes interest, lease rentals received and miscellaneous income.

8 Previous year/quarter figures have been re arranged/regrouped where ever considered necessary.
